text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Penepian Fi kepada Pelatih di

Pusat Bertauliah) 2016.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 November 2015.

Penepian fi

2. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperaturan (2), fi yang ditetapkan dalam

butiran 3(a)(i) Jadual kepada Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan Kemahiran

Kebangsaan (Fi dan Caj) 2006 [P.U. (A) 409/2006] diketepikan berkenaan dengan

seseorang pelatih yang memohon bagi pengiktirafan kemahiran yang membawa kepada

anugerah Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia melalui pusat bertauliah sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual.

(2) Penepian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) terpakai bagi permohonan

pengiktirafan kemahiran yang dibuat dalam tempoh dua tahun sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual.

Pembayaran balik fi

3. (1) Pelatih yang disebut dalam peraturan 2 yang telah membayar fi yang

ditetapkan dalam butiran 3(a)(i) Jadual kepada Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan

Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Fi dan Caj) 2006 boleh memohon kepada Ketua Pengarah bagi

pembayaran balik fi itu.

(2) Apabila permohonan di bawah subperaturan (1) diterima, Ketua

Pengarah hendaklah, selepas ditentusahkan, membayar balik fi yang telah dibayar oleh

pelatih itu.

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (WAIVER OF FEE TO TRAINEE AT

ACCREDITED CENTRE) REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of the

National Skills Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development

(Waiver of Fee to Trainee at Accredited Centre) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 November 2015.

Waiver of fee

2. (1) Subject to subregulation (2), the fee prescribed in item 3(a)(i) of the

Schedule to the National Skills Development (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2006

[P.U. (A) 409/2006] is waived in respect of a trainee who applies for the recognition of

skills leading to the award of the Malaysian Skills Certificate through the accredited

centre as specified in column (1) of the Schedule.

(2) The waiver of fee under subregulation (1) applies to the application for

the recognition of skills made within the period of two years as specified in column (2)

of the Schedule.

Refund of fee

3. (1) The trainee referred to in regulation 2 who has paid the fee prescribed in

item 3(a)(i) of the Schedule to the National Skills Development (Fees and Charges)

Regulations 2006 may apply to the Director General for a refund of the fee.

(2) Upon receipt of the application under subregulation (1), the

Director General shall, after verification, refund the fee paid by the trainee.

SCHEDULE
